name: Au Brandz Co.,Ltd
summary: Based in Seoul, South Korea, Au Brandz Co., Ltd. operates as a retailer specializing in apparel and accessories. Established in 2022, the company functions as a subsidiary of Au Commerce Co., Ltd. It offers a comprehensive selection of products, including a diverse range of cold-weather garments and accessories such as quilted coats, cardigans, pullovers, bustiers, berets, hats, beanies, scarves, mittens, gloves, earmuffs, corsages, and leg and arm warmers. Additionally, their footwear collection is extensive, featuring sneaker boots, sneakers, flats, Mary Janes, mules, various boot styles, winter slippers, slip-ons, slingbacks, clogs, and rain boots. The company also provides practical items like backpacks, duffle bags, shopping bags, umbrellas, and rain ponchos.
